author: Uramaki Fan
title: Nice app
content: Pretty cool and have a lot of information, well based and smooth. It’s clearly a project from who like UI/UX Universe. I didn’t give five stars because there’s something to improve like more languages. I could assign a premium version if you have these options.

title: Very good but some polish needed
content:
Overall I have been enjoying it very much!

The app is good, the interactions are nice and the content is top notch.

There are just a couple points that I have found so far, in my first week using, that needs to be addressed:

1 - I go to bookmarks tab, it tells me that I don’t have any courses bookmarked, so I go to the courses page as instructed, but there are no way to bookmark the courses there, which is confusing.

2 - Another point is there’s no way to redo the test of a section, revisiting the topic you studied is crucial for learning, please add this possibility, it’s just redoing the same test that I just did.

author: nandi.gab
title: Great platform
content: I was expecting so much this app to be released. It’s great, the only thing is when I open the app it lead me to a course I’ve finished already. I was lost trying to find the other courses and go to the one I’m doing now. This is the only thing, all the rest is great!

author: Gabe Attilio
title: Easier courses access
content: Loved to have a smooth access to the courses, the experience is really simple and easy. What I miss is the relation with the career paths, and ability to make the assessments, that I believe that would be nice to have in the future.
